<description>
This should help to debug/fix https://github.com/hebasto/bitcoin-core-nightly/issues/368, but seems independently useful to avoid unbounded-time test runs.

Also rework the `413`-code tests where a pre-existing issue was made more likely by the first commit.
</description>

<commits>
fab1529ebc test: Set socket timeout in interface_http.py

Currently, the socket timeout in BitcoinHTTPConnection is not set, and
sometimes reset (redundantly) to None.

Fix both issues by using the RPC timeout of the node, which should be
large enough to cover all use-cases.

Specific tests can still call set_timeout() if they need to.

fa5551cc6d test: Rework 413 Too Large tests in interface_http.py

The tests had a few small problems:

* The comment claimed that the send operation was blocking until
  timeout. However, a send should terminate once the server closes the
  socket.
* The test possibly force-closed the connection, instead of testing the
  outcome that the server closes it.
* The test tried to read a "413 Content too large", but such an outcome
  is not guaranteed when the server is closing the connection.

Fix all issues, by adjusting the comments and asserting the server
closes the connection.  The error code is only asserted in the debug
log.
</commits>
